definition: Naturally spreading its qualities or influence from itself to others.
author: Marcus Aurelius
quote: Reason is of a diffusive nature, what itself is in itself, it begets in others, and so doth multiply.
example_sentence: Her laugh has a diffusive quality, and soon the whole carriage is giggling.
